Port crank chamber drum, including cam, cam gears, punch rods, etc.
Primary and secondary sparkers and wires

components.name: Hollow crankshaft and single crank pin
components.function: Carry the load of five rods and deliver torque and oil
components.interfaces: Two bronze main bushings, master sleeve, balance-arm flanges, worm wheel, cam pinion, ignition ring
components.decision: One steel forging: hollow shaft, one crank arm, one hollow crank pin carrying the cone-nut threads that were left from the pure-slipper design; oil path drilled through shaft, arm and pin; arm and pin proportions measured from Plate 78

components.name: Main bearing bushings
components.function: Carry the shaft in each drum hub
components.interfaces: Drum hubs, shaft journals, oil grooves
components.decision: Bronze bushings with the circular oil groove on the port side

components.name: Coupling flanges
components.function: Join the transmission shafts to the crankshaft and clamp the balance arms
components.interfaces: Crankshaft ends, balance arms, transmission shafts (outside)
components.decision: Flange pair at each shaft end; bolt circle estimated; transmission shafts excluded

components.name: Balance arms with braces
components.function: Balance the reciprocating masses at a large radius for little weight
components.decision: Flat arm bolted between the flanges ending in a lozenge lug, inclined tube brace at about 30 degrees to a plate on the lug and a collar on the shaft; sizes measured from Plates 79 and 80

components.name: Master connecting rod, split sleeve and bronze lining
components.function: Carry load directly to the crank pin and carry the four slipper shoes on its sleeve
components.interfaces: Crank pin, gudgeon pin, link shoes, cone nuts
components.decision: 7/8 in solid steel rod whose forged upper sleeve half is integral; cap half; bronze lining split at right angles to the sleeve; sleeve turned round except where the rod joins it; threads for the cone nuts; how the halves are held together is not drawn clearly enough to state

components.name: Link rods with bronze slipper shoes
components.function: Carry piston load into the master sleeve while sliding on it
components.interfaces: Gudgeon pins, master sleeve, cone nuts
components.decision: 7/8 in rods with a 5/8 in hole; bronze shoe about 55 to 60 degrees wide, width and rod length measured together from Plate 78 (closure check in operating-motion.md)

components.name: Little-end bushings
components.function: Bear the gudgeon pins
components.decision: Bronze bushings with oil grooves in all five rod heads

components.name: Sleeve cone nuts and jam nuts
components.function: Hold the four shoes on the sleeve and allow wear adjustment
components.decision: One tapered nut at each end of the sleeve locked by a jam nut; thread detail not modelled

components.name: Pistons
components.function: Transmit gas load; cast iron, domed two-rib crown, thin walls
components.decision: Cast-iron piston with domed crown and two deep thin reinforcing ribs; clearance 0.127 mm at the middle and 0.19 mm at the ends; wall and crown thickness measured, the lighter set drawn

components.name: Piston rings
components.function: Seal the piston
components.decision: Four lap-joint rings narrower than their grooves by 0.0508 to 0.0889 mm (documented), 1/64 in lap clearance; ring section estimated

components.name: Gudgeon pins and retainers
components.function: Join piston to rod
components.decision: Hollow case-hardened steel tubes 7/8 in outside diameter (bore not given); retaining screws shown at both ends in Plate 78, count and form read from the plate

components.name: Cylinder shells with integral heads
components.function: Contain the pressure
components.interfaces: Liner, flange, combustion chamber, jacket, spark plug
components.decision: Seamless 1/16 in steel shell with domed head formed integral (cold-drawn closed-end tube, M1 and A1); plug boss in the dome

components.name: Cylinder mounting flanges
components.function: Bolt each cylinder to the drum rings
components.decision: Flange screwed and brazed on near the shell bottom; drilled with a jig to fit the drum rings (A1 p. 180)

components.name: Cast-iron liners
components.function: Wearing surface for the piston
components.decision: 1/16 in wall, shrunk into the shell and bored in place

components.name: Forged combustion chambers with exhaust chamber and outlet
components.function: Carry the valves and the side port into the cylinder; keep exhaust off the port bearing
components.interfaces: Shell (brazed), jacket, inlet seat, exhaust seat, guide
components.decision: Machined from a solid steel forging and brazed to the shell near the top; chamber below the exhaust seat with a side outlet; internal passages read from Plate 78

components.name: Sheet-steel water jackets
components.function: Contain coolant around shell and chamber
components.interfaces: Shell, chamber, jacket ring, water stubs
components.decision: 0.020 in sheet steel brazed on, ending in a ring that encircles the cylinder near mid-length; inlet and outlet stubs read from Plate 78

components.name: Automatic inlet valves, seats and springs
components.function: Admit mixture on suction with no drive
components.interfaces: Chamber, removable cast-iron seat, nut, manifold branch
components.decision: Cast-iron seat held by a nut in the upper part of each chamber; valve with a stem, a spring and a cap; lift illustrative

components.name: Exhaust valves, guides and springs
components.function: Release exhaust when struck by the punch rod
components.decision: Stem passes through a long coil spring and ends 1/64 in above the punch rod; lift illustrative; seat angle and head diameter measured

components.name: Spark plugs
components.function: Ignite each charge
components.decision: Central plug in each dome with the metal part extended about 3/4 in beyond the porcelain and a platinum wire counter-electrode (M1 pp. 221-222); form read from Plate 78

components.name: Piston oil cups and tubes
components.function: Gravity-feed oil to each piston
components.decision: Crescent-shaped cups of 0.003 in sheet steel, riveted and soldered, holding about an hour of oil; tubes through the wall at equal intervals

components.name: Cylinder-to-drum bolts
components.function: Clamp the flanges to the drum rings
components.decision: Four bolts per flange; count and circle are an estimate from Plates 78 and 79

components.name: Port crank-chamber drum (head, hub and knee brackets)
components.function: Support the shaft and the cylinders on the exhaust side and carry the valve gear
components.interfaces: Port bushing, flanges, port bed plate, cam ring, punch-rod guides
components.decision: Built-up steel drum with symmetric hub, two cylinder rings and knee brackets; flanged bushing with tongues and grooves joins the hub to the bed plate with a gap for the cam and punch rods

components.name: Starboard crank-chamber drum
components.function: Support the shaft on the ignition side
components.decision: Drum like the port one; the starboard bed plate web is drawn against its face by bolts

components.name: Double-pointed ring cam
components.function: Lift all five exhaust valves
components.decision: Annular cam journalled on the port hub, two lobes, internal teeth for the reversing drive; profile illustrative (slant was reduced on 8 January 1902)

components.name: Cam reduction gear train
components.function: Drive the cam at one quarter crank speed in reverse
components.interfaces: Crankshaft pinion, studs on the drum, cam ring teeth
components.decision: Reversing train of three external meshes (pinion to large gear, small gear to idler, idler to cam-ring teeth), net 1:4 reverse; tooth counts 24/48/18/12/36 (pinion, large gear, small gear, idler, cam-ring teeth) derived to give exactly 1:4 with no two gears of a plane overlapping, layout interpreted from a very crowded plate

components.name: Punch rods, rollers and guides
components.function: Transmit cam lift to the exhaust stems
components.interfaces: Cam ring, guide, exhaust stem 1/64 in above
components.decision: Hardened rollers on the cam; rods slide in guides on the port drum; 1/64 in gap documented

components.name: Port lubrication
components.function: Feed the port bearing, hollow shaft and crank pin
components.decision: Small oil cup on the port bed plate feeding the hub groove

components.name: Ignition drive sleeve and gears
components.function: Drive the sparker cam and distributor from the crankshaft
components.interfaces: Starboard hub, ring on the crankshaft, sparker gear, distributor gear
components.decision: Gear formed on a sleeve that telescopes over the starboard hub and ends in a ring fixed to the crankshaft; gear train read from Plate 81, tooth counts to be read or derived to give 2.5x and 0.5x

components.name: Primary sparker
components.function: Make and break the primary circuit five times in two revolutions
components.interfaces: Sparker cam, pawl and spring, contact, coil (outside)
components.decision: One-lobe cam at 2.5x acting on a pawl on a spring; wire contact; read from Plate 81

components.name: Secondary distributor and wires
components.function: Distribute the high-tension spark to the five plugs
components.interfaces: Distributor disc, five-section commutator, wires, plugs
components.decision: Disc at 0.5x with a brush over a five-section commutator in hard rubber (after red fibre failed); wires insulated by telescoped rubber tubing; routing illustrative

components.name: Spark timing handle
components.function: Adjust the timing of the spark
components.decision: Long handle with a wing nut visible in Plate 81; role interpreted from the plate (not captioned); only the portion inside the assembly is modelled

components.name: Bed plates
components.function: Carry each drum and hang the engine on the Aerodrome frame
components.decision: Elongated-diamond steel tubing with a sheet-steel web brazed to the tubes (A1 p. 179 affidavit, consistent with Plate 81); frame tubes and clamps excluded

components.name: Starting mechanism
components.function: Let the aviator restart the engine in the air
components.interfaces: Worm wheel on the crankshaft, sliding worm, tubular shaft, two brackets
components.decision: Sliding worm on a tongued and grooved tubular shaft, spring pawl plug and release wire; shaft ends at the Aerodrome cross-frame where the ratchet crank begins (the crank and ratchet are outside)

components.name: Pump drive
components.function: Drive the circulating pump at three times engine speed
components.interfaces: Bevel gear on the worm-wheel hub, pinion, vertical splined shaft
components.decision: Bevel pair and the upper part of the vertical shaft with its telescoping splined joint; the pump and the lower shaft are outside the assembly

components.name: Inlet gas manifold
components.function: Distribute mixture to the five automatic inlet valves
components.decision: Tube bent to a circle with five branches (the branch tubes are part of the three segments), cut in three places and joined by flanges; rotating sleeve air valve on the vertical pipe; the connection to the carburetor ends at the assembly boundary

components.name: Water inlet manifold
components.function: Deliver coolant to the five jackets
components.interfaces: Jacket inlet stubs, vertical riser to the pump (outside)
components.decision: Circular manifold on the starboard side meeting the five inlet stubs (the short rubber connections are omitted); riser stops at the assembly boundary

components.name: Water outlet manifold
components.function: Collect heated water from the jackets and return it to the radiators
components.interfaces: Jacket outlet stubs, two connections to the radiators (outside)
components.decision: Circular manifold on the port side with two connections, meeting the five outlet stubs (rubber connections omitted); radiators outside

components.name: Flywheels (two) with tangent wire spokes
components.function: Smooth the torque fluctuations after the transmission shafts overheated without them
components.interfaces: Crankshaft hubs, spokes, rims, balance arms (clear)
components.decision: Final form: aluminium casting rims of U section, special steel hubs on the crankshaft, 24 tangent wire spokes of No. 10 coppered steel wire (24 documented for the starboard wheel; port assumed equal); 33 in diameter documented for the first steel rims and assumed for the aluminium ones; rim weight inversely proportional to distance from the crank-pin centre (table: starboard 3,946 g, port 3,234 g); spoke crossing pattern read from Plates 83 and 84

components.name: Transmission-shaft stubs
components.function: Show where the transmission shafts couple to the engine
components.decision: Short tubular stubs of 1.5 in outside diameter beyond each coupling flange (M1 p. 242); the shafts, gears and propellers are outside

components.name: Spark coil and batteries
components.function: Supply primary current
components.decision: Separate accessory in the weight table

components.name: Carburetor and its inlet pipe
components.function: Mix fuel and air (tupelo-wood tank warmed by air from the cylinders)
components.decision: Separate accessories; the carburetor is a design study of its own (M1 pp. 224-225)

components.name: Gasoline tank and water tank
components.function: Store fuel and coolant
components.decision: Separate accessories

components.name: Circulating pump and lower shaft
components.function: Circulate coolant
components.decision: Pump outside the assembly; upper shaft and bevel gears are inside (L34)

components.name: Radiator (finned tubes)
components.function: Reject heat
components.decision: Separate accessory sized for the Aerodrome frame

components.name: Aerodrome frame, transmission shafts, gears and propellers
components.function: Carry the engine and deliver thrust
components.decision: The bed plates attach to the frame tubes; the frame is not part of the engine

mechanisms.path: piston -> gudgeon pin -> bronze bushing -> rod (master direct; link rod through its slipper shoe on the master sleeve) -> split sleeve and bronze lining -> crank pin -> crank arm -> hollow shaft -> two bronze bushings -> drums -> bed plates
checks: shoe arcs never overlap at any crank angle (rod length and shoe width together)
master rod and four link rods give identical piston strokes

mechanisms.path: crank pinion -> compound reversing gear train -> double-lobed ring cam (-1/4 speed) -> five punch-rod rollers and rods -> 1/64 in gap -> exhaust stem -> valve head -> spring return
carburetor (outside) -> circular manifold in three flanged segments -> five branches -> removable cast-iron seats -> automatic inlet valves (suction, spring) -> chamber -> cylinder
cylinder -> exhaust valve -> chamber below the seat -> side outlet away from the port bearing
checks: outlet clear of the port main bearing

mechanisms.path: pump (outside) -> starboard circular manifold -> five jackets -> port circular manifold -> two connections to the radiators (outside)

crankshaft -> sleeve and ring -> sparker gear -> one-lobe cam (2.5x) lifts pawl and breaks the primary circuit five times per two revolutions -> coil (outside) -> distributor brush (0.5x) on five-section commutator -> wire -> plug

port oil cup -> hub groove -> hole in hollow shaft -> pipe in plug -> hole in crank arm -> hollow pin -> holes -> master bushing -> holes -> under the four shoes; five piston cups -> tubes -> pistons; centrifugal oil along the rods to the gudgeon pins
crankshaft -> hubs -> 24 tangent wire spokes each -> aluminium U-section rims (inertia); balance arms bolted between the coupling flanges at 30 degrees brace
checks: rim mass per table (3,946 g starboard, 3,234 g port)
balance arm clear of rim and spokes at every angle

mechanisms.path: crank handle (outside) -> ratchet -> tubular shaft -> sliding worm -> worm wheel on crankshaft; bevel gear on its hub -> pinion -> vertical splined shaft -> pump at 3x (outside)
checks: worm held out of mesh by pawl

Different inclusion boundaries; target is Manly's table of the engine proper, 124.17 lb
Seamless steel shell (M1, A1) over "spun" (brief) and "drawn from steel plates" (secondary); copper jackets rejected, sheet steel 0.020 in (M1)
Model describes the engine as built; priority claims are recorded in research.md as contested (Millet 1889, Corliss 1857, Balzer 1894 rotary radial wagon)

conflicts.topic: Slipper bearing versus knuckle-pin master rod
conflicts.decision: Slipper shoes sliding on the master sleeve (M1 p. 238); not a pinned master-and-link rod; all five pistons have identical strokes
Firing order 1-3-5-2-4 documented; consecutive numbering in the direction of crank rotation adopted as modelling choice; cylinder 1 at the top
Built and drawn 1901, tested 1902-1904, flown (launched) 1903; museum label 1901, NASM record 1903
Affidavits of 1933 used only for construction facts that agree with M1
